name: South Elgin (United States)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue, a vertical blue stripe through the centre, red rectangles in the corners each with a yellow star, and the name SOUTH ELGIN in black between two yellow stars on the white.
history: South Elgin is a village in Kane County, Illinois. The flag was adopted in 1976 (designed by Robert W. Claunch and chosen in a contest of the South Elgin Bicentennial Commission in 1976, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: red rectangles in the four corners
stars in the corners and flanking the name
vertical blue stripe through the centre
